title: The scheduler was about to attach a day-old number to a fresh round
symptom: The round's training wrote to mega_iterm1_curated_s101/train2 while train/ still held the previous day's M1 run; _train_metric globbed the plain train path and would have published 0.5873 from 04:52 as the result of a round that started at 15:05.
root_cause: Ultralytics increments the run directory and the reader took a fixed path, with no freshness or ownership check.
correction_made: _train_metric(started_ts) takes the newest results.csv under mega_iter*/train*/ and accepts it only if written after the step started, otherwise logs the refusal and attaches no metric. WP1 later replaced this with a job-scoped artifact read by job id.
